title: Read-only photo catalog and album selection reconciliation

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Bind actual working folder, selection directory and mounted library; never guess paths or infer identity from cloud thumbnails.
Verify catalog freshness against selection/library changes; rebuild only through a separately authorized index invocation.
Selection files must all be readable; exact absolute paths disambiguate. Missing real files and ambiguous basenames remain holds.
Reports may overwrite only their bound derived destinations, never database, source selection or original photo files.
Read CSV status and real file existence as well as exit code; clean reconciliation does not authorize arranging or editing.

success_checks: Both CSVs read back; every selection mention has a resolved, ambiguous or missing result.
Resolved means one actual readable file; chronological order retains date provenance and cannot promote filesystem time to capture time.
Any unreadable, missing or ambiguous input stops downstream album actions and names the smallest specific correction.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
